capabilities.statement: a caller and the app exchange JSON-RPC 2.0 objects over one local socket
capabilities.mechanism: one request/response shape shared by the client and the server, so a method is a name and a params object

capabilities.statement: the same protocol runs over a Unix socket or a Windows named pipe
capabilities.mechanism: one transport module per platform behind an identical connect call; callers do not branch

capabilities.statement: a client call fails with a timeout instead of hanging
capabilities.mechanism: the client bounds each call and surfaces the elapsed budget in the error

capabilities.statement: a refused call carries the handler's own sentence and code, not a nested envelope
capabilities.mechanism: the drain loop answers the handler's error object and the Rust edge builds the RPC error from it

capabilities.statement: a caller reads the running app's version over the control surface
capabilities.mechanism: registered in the native server from the crate's own version string

capabilities.statement: a caller can ask the app to exit
capabilities.mechanism: a native handler on the same server; deliberately not published as an MCP tool

capabilities.statement: a caller creates a pane of a known type and gets its stable id back
capabilities.mechanism: the type is checked against the pane registry and the reply carries the persisted `attachment_id`

capabilities.statement: a caller lists panes with their id, type, label and focus state
capabilities.mechanism: one read over the live tile set; ids are the public ones, not engine session ids

capabilities.statement: a caller closes a pane by its id
capabilities.mechanism: resolves the id to a tile, frees the pane, and does not touch a sibling's state

capabilities.statement: a caller moves focus to a named pane
capabilities.mechanism: focus is a workspace-level call so the reply can report the previous holder

capabilities.statement: a caller moves a pane into another slot of the grid
capabilities.mechanism: the tile set is swapped in place; the pane keeps its id and its pty

capabilities.statement: a caller writes text into a pane's pty
capabilities.mechanism: the bytes go through the pane's own write path, so a running program sees them as input

capabilities.statement: a caller reads a pane's screen text back
capabilities.mechanism: the grid's plain-text rows are packed for the wire; no escape bytes survive

capabilities.statement: a pane reports its type, grid size, scrollback rows and child exit code
capabilities.mechanism: primitives only, so a caller can poll without parsing prose

capabilities.statement: a caller reads one addressed element of a pane's body by kind
capabilities.mechanism: the pane body answers a routed-content contract, so a new pane type does not add a verb

capabilities.statement: a caller changes a pane's runtime settings
capabilities.mechanism: one settings choke point per pane, with file-sourced and runtime-sourced keys distinguished

capabilities.statement: a settings write answers the keys it dropped, so a caller learns instead of guessing
capabilities.mechanism: the sanitizer returns the filtered settings and the refused names in the same reply

capabilities.statement: a caller runs a command in a pane and gets a handle to wait on
capabilities.mechanism: argv only, validated like a spawn; never a shell string

capabilities.statement: a caller waits for a pattern in a pane's output, bounded by a deadline
capabilities.mechanism: polls the same text the read verb returns, so a wait cannot see more than a read

capabilities.statement: one input can be delivered to several panes at once
capabilities.mechanism: the caller names the targets; the reply reports per-pane success

capabilities.statement: a named layout can be saved and restored as a set of tiles
capabilities.mechanism: the tile set is serialized through the same sanitizer a restore runs, and listing names what exists

capabilities.statement: a caller lists workspaces and sees which one is active
capabilities.mechanism: the store is the source; the reply marks the active workspace by name

capabilities.statement: the concept set can be listed and a concept toggled over the control surface
capabilities.mechanism: the same engine store the settings UI writes, so a toggle is visible everywhere at once

capabilities.statement: a plugin install is a review handshake the user answers, not a write a caller can finish alone
capabilities.mechanism: the CLI stages the clone and the GUI asks; consent is remembered by the trust store

capabilities.statement: the running app learns of a CLI-side plugin change without a restart
capabilities.mechanism: a notify verb after the store is written, so the GUI reloads the registry it reads

capabilities.statement: an MCP call reaches only a published tool, not any method its kebab name could spell
capabilities.mechanism: the requested name is checked against the generated tool list before the name-to-method mapping runs

capabilities.statement: a tool argument is translated from the CLI definition, and an unknown key is refused with the nearest valid one
capabilities.mechanism: the wire table derives each argument's JSON type and refuses a wrong type or contradictory pair

capabilities.statement: a pane's event socket carries only what that pane is entitled to emit
capabilities.mechanism: the connection is bound to one capability at accept time, so a socket cannot speak for another pane

capabilities.statement: the list of readable vault roots can only be changed in the pane settings UI
capabilities.mechanism: no verb, layout, profile or plugin can register a root; the handlers answer only inside the list
